skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate and edit AI images through the inference.sh belt CLI using GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and other hosted models.
skill.summary: Create, edit, upscale, and combine images with hosted AI models through the belt CLI.
skill.author: skillssh

security_audit.summary: All 44 external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, and eight URL alerts are documentation links or placeholders. The embedded remote image is a confirmed low-risk network request, while semantic review identified unpinned installation instructions and remote processing of prompts and images.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends unpinned third-party installations and mutable main-branch instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin packages and skill references to reviewed versions or commits, provide integrity information, and explain the trust boundary before installation.

remediation.issue: Generation and editing can transmit prompts and image references to external model services.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose remote processing and data retention terms, and require confirmation before sending sensitive or private material.

remediation.issue: The skill embeds an externally hosted image that may load when the document renders.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the image locally or serve it through an approved marketplace asset proxy.

content.user_title: Generate Images with Hosted AI Models
content.value_statement: Choosing and invoking image models can require many provider-specific commands. This skill supplies belt CLI workflows for generation, editing, upscaling, and image composition.
actual_capabilities: Lists hosted image models and their intended strengths.
Provides text-to-image commands for GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Reve, and Seedream.
Shows GPT-Image-2 editing with a source image URL.
Provides an image upscaling workflow using Topaz.
Shows how to stitch multiple image URLs horizontally.
Lists related skills for specialized image and video tasks.
limitations: Requires the separately installed belt CLI and an authenticated inference.sh account.
Depends on external services, model availability, pricing, and provider policies.
Examples do not guarantee output quality, exact text rendering, or consistent model behavior.
Prompts and image references may be processed outside the local environment.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate social graphics and product concepts across several hosted models.

use_cases.title: Prototype Art Directions
use_cases.description: Compare visual treatments quickly before selecting a production direction.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Preparation
use_cases.description: Generate, upscale, edit, and combine assets from repeatable CLI workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image of [subject] in [style] with [lighting]. Use a suitable belt image model and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the listed models for [goal], [aspect ratio], and [quality requirement]. Recommend one model, then generate the image.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the image at [image URL]. Preserve [elements], change [requested area], and use [desired visual direction].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Production Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] variations for [campaign]. Compare two suitable models, upscale the selected result, and document each completed step.

output_examples.input: Generate a wide cyberpunk city scene with neon signs and rainy streets.
output_examples.output: Selected Grok Imagine for its aspect-ratio support and generated a 16:9 city scene. The result is ready for review.

output_examples.input: Change this product photo background to a beach sunset while preserving the product.
output_examples.output: Used GPT-Image-2 editing with the supplied image reference. The product remains centered against a beach sunset background.

output_examples.input: Upscale the selected illustration for a large presentation.
output_examples.output: Submitted the illustration to the Topaz upscaler and returned the enhanced image location for inspection.

best_practices: State the subject, composition, style, lighting, and aspect ratio before generation.
Confirm privacy and usage rights before submitting prompts or image references.
Review a lower-cost draft before requesting high-resolution generation or upscaling.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential images without reviewing the external service policy.
Do not assume every model accepts identical parameters or aspect ratios.
Do not install mutable third-party skills without verifying their source and version.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill work without internet access?
faq.answer: No. The belt CLI uses hosted inference.sh applications and requires network access.

faq.question: Is a separate account required?
faq.answer: Yes. The quick start requires belt login before running a model.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a GPT-Image-2 workflow using an image URL.

faq.question: Can it improve image resolution?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a Topaz image upscaling example.

faq.question: Are prompts and images processed locally?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow submits requests to hosted applications, so review privacy requirements first.
